necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia and underlying atrial fibrillation. Given the intermittent nature of these symptoms and the need for continuous rhythm correlation over an extended period, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is ordered to capture arrhythmic events and guide further management. This clinical indication supports the medical necessity of CPT 93229 despite the denial based on Reason Code CO-197.
